info.title: Proposed Ascension provider-session product API
info.description: Additive to implemented Phases 1–3. Server derives actor/scope/state; native turn submission is not exposed. The minimal command envelope references a server-created policy/plan/draft; authoritative records are response schemas, not writable DTOs.
